$comment: Phrases that may not appear in a product claim in this site's own voice.
SOURCE OF TRUTH: ADR 0033, 'Explicitly forbidden designs', item 7, in
ai-agent-assembly/agent-assembly at docs/src/adr/
0033-canonical-governance-and-enforcement-architecture.md. That list is
the source; this file is a synced copy, because this gate must run with
no network access (AAASM-5616 acceptance criterion: company-site
deployment stays independent and resilient). A copy that cannot be
fetched is the price of a gate that cannot be broken by an outage.
The ban is UNWAIVABLE. ADR 0034 Decision 10 places it outside the waiver
mechanism entirely: a waiver may reach process, timing or review
sequencing, and may never reach whether a statement is true. There is no
approver to ask, so this file carries no exceptions list.
TO EXTEND: amend ADR 0033 first, then sync here and bump last_synced.
A phrase absent from ADR 0033's list is a phrase no gate in the org
catches; adding it here only and not upstream hides that from everyone
else.
DELIBERATELY NOT IMPORTED: the product website's `rejected-hero` class.
That class is scoped to an L1 hero position — it bans the framing
AAASM-5585 removed from agent-assembly.com's homepage. Its
`governance {unit} for` template matches this site's product blurb
literally, and that blurb is the sentence content-ownership.md holds up
as the worked example of a COMPLIANT L0 summary. Importing the class
would fail this build on the one sentence a canonical source calls
correct. The collision is recorded as F12 in
design/product-narrative-hierarchy.md and is filed for a ruling.
Also not imported: fd-1 through fd-6, fd-8 and fd-9. Those bind
architecture descriptions, which this site does not author (it is L0 —
it may not author a per-capability status, a platform claim, or an
architecture narrative at all). fd-7 is the item that binds every layer
including this one.
Negative controls. Each string below contains a banned phrase as a
SUBSTRING but is not an instance of it. If a naive substring matcher
replaces the word-boundary matcher, these fire and the gate fails —
which is the point. A matcher that cannot tell 'complete' from
'incomplete' would either be disabled by whoever it blocked, or
trained around.
Positive controls. Each must be detected on every run. A gate that
reports zero findings without proving it can still find anything is a
gate that has silently stopped working — an empty result and a broken
detector look identical from the outside.
